issues.body: `artifact_covers_crate()` still returns true for any token-delimited crate name anywhere in a matched file. Consequently a comment or another surface's blurb in `surfaces.ts`, an unrelated book-page cross-reference, or a crate mention in `SUMMARY.md` alone suppresses the crate's follow-on even though no crate-specific site entry or complete guide chapter exists. The new tests do not cover these cases: they test a valid README include and a file containing no crate mention, leaving the prior false-suppression paths intact.
issues.fix_hint: Parse or structurally validate the relevant artifact. For the site rule, require a Surface entry whose crate-specific README/href identifies the evaluated crate. For the guide rule, require both a SUMMARY chapter link and its corresponding guide page, with that page's include target identifying the crate README or SKILL. Add negative tests for comment/blurb-only mentions, unrelated cross-references, and SUMMARY-only crate mentions.
issues.title: Bare crate-name mentions still suppress follow-ons without proving artifact coverage

verdict.summary: Round 4 leaves the round-3 major finding materially unchanged. Suppression is still based on any token-delimited crate-name occurrence anywhere in a matched shared artifact. The added positive guide test proves only that an include works, while the negative test proves only that a file with no crate mention does not suppress; neither distinguishes a real site Surface record or complete mdBook chapter from a comment, blurb, cross-reference, or SUMMARY-only mention. Those weak mentions can therefore still suppress the only follow-on for unfinished work. Progress is stagnant.
